recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit for FHIR-20003. If PA wants the same editorial cleanup applied to Person, Practitioner, or RelatedPerson core search parameters, handle that as a separate focused tracker rather than broadening this Patient-specific reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-20003 was a Published FHIR-core Patient change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution to change the Patient:name HumanName field list from "give" to "given" and remove the duplicate "suffix" term.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20003 was found. The old Patient-name wording entered the current search-parameter bundle during the 2021 source rework and was corrected by commit e6a9a72025eeda3b1b5e3ee29af2c350f5809762, a commit labeled for FHIR-25446 that also changed Patient-name to "family, given, prefix, suffix, and/or text".
additional_context: Patient is active in source/fhir.ini, so source/patient/bundle-Patient-search-params.xml is in current build scope. PA minutes on 2022-03-02 recorded FHIR-20003 as already voted and needing update because the change was applied. Later core Patient issue FHIR-39454 was resolved No Change because the R5 fix was already applied. A bounded source search found the same typo in Person, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, and an HTML source comment, but those are outside this Patient-specific Jira decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Patient-name SearchParameter description already says "A server defined search that may match any of the string fields in the HumanName, including family, given, prefix, suffix, and/or text".
